recorded_from_commit_note: CARD-201's implementation: the guide grows from one page to two (the full 'how to solve' tutorial, FR-041's own deferred clause), so every interior page from the first puzzle/divider page onward moves one page later. This file records the NEW, current truth (all 13 pages of tests.helpers.book_corpus.baseline_puzzles on corpus_book), not a diff against book_baseline_card198.json: see tests/test_book_pdf_memory.py's TestBookPdfMemory_EveryPageAfterTheGuideIsByteIdenticalShiftedByOne for how G-2/AC-6 (every page after the guide keeps its content, shifted by one) is verified instead, since a page inserted before the puzzle section flips every later page's parity (recto/verso) and COMP-007 mirrors a book page's margins by parity (ADR-0036), so no later page is byte-identical to its pre-card self even though its content is unchanged.
re_recorded_for_review_cycle_1_fix: Still CARD-201, still before merge (not a new superseding card): re-recorded after review cycle 1's F-1 and F-3 fixes, both of which deliberately change guide page 2's own ink -- F-1 replaced the mathematically-wrong 'keep what every arrangement agrees on' worked example (clue (3,), length 10, which this file's prior recording had baked in as 'correct' pixels) with a verified-correct one (clue (3,), length 5); F-3 fixed the pipeline diagram's last box missing its right border. Only interior page 2's digest and interior_bytes/colour_interior_bytes moved; every other page's digest, the page count and the font_fingerprint are unchanged from the prior recording (diffed before writing this note). This is the one case the fixture's own 'warning' field above allows: real news about a deliberate content change under test, not noise silenced away.
re_recorded_for_review_cycle_2_fix: Still CARD-201, still before merge: re-recorded after review cycle 2's F-11 fix, which deliberately changes guide page 2's own ink again -- the paste loop was subtracting the frame's own heavy-rule width ('pad') from EVERY pasted diagram's x-offset uniformly, which is only correct for a draw_example_line/example_line_layout image (those bake in a left bleed margin of exactly that width); the pipeline diagram and the difficulty box draw their own border flush at column 0 with no such margin, so applying the same correction shifted both one heavy-rule-width too far left. Fixed by tagging each pasted mark with its own needs_pad flag and pasting the pipeline diagram and the difficulty box unshifted. Only interior page 2's digest and interior_bytes/colour_interior_bytes moved (both diagrams shift right by `pad`, a few pixels); every other page's digest, the page count and the font_fingerprint are unchanged from the prior recording (diffed before writing this note, same as review cycle 1's). This is the one case the fixture's own 'warning' field above allows: real news about a deliberate, reviewed content-position fix, not noise silenced away.
read_back_through: tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages — the pages decoded out of the exported interior PDF, not the in-memory bitmaps
why_a_new_baseline: CARD-201 grows the guide from one page to two (FR-041's deferred 'full 1-2 page tutorial' clause): the interior grows from 12 pages to 13, and every page from interior page 2 onward in CARD-198's recording moves to interior page N+1 here. Pages 1-2 (the new 2-page guide) are new content; every page from 3 onward carries the same content CARD-198's page N-1 carried, at its own new parity.
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looks like as of CARD-201. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test fail less: a digest that no longer matches means a page's ink changed, and an interior_bytes mismatch means the file's length changed — either is real news about the change under test, not noise to silence.
interior_colorspace_note: What every page of this interior declares (CARD-147's own fact, unaffected by CARD-201). NOT the same as each page entry's 'mode' below, which is 'RGB' and always will be: that field is what tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages normalises every page to before digesting it, regardless of the file's own declared colour space.
font_fingerprint_note: This machine's Arial-or-fallback fingerprint, reproduced before this file was written (tests.helpers.book_corpus.font_fingerprint). A machine with a different fingerprint skips the font_dependent_pages below rather than failing on them.

None of the four answer pages (10-13) are machine-lettered.

The difference from CARD-198 is the guide's new second page's own JPEG stream, plus whatever margin-mirroring shift moves every later page's ink by a few pixels (G-2: same content, not necessarily the same bytes, once parity flips); the difference from this file's own prior recording is page 2's pipeline diagram and difficulty box each moving right by `pad` (review cycle 2's F-11 fix).
